ResearchTabDef.label: Dead Man Switch
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Nara Industries is made up of countless colonial fleets that travel endlessly between star systems developing new worlds; nobody knows what motivates them. Their colonial fleets tend to spread technology to every living world they moor at, justified as the advancement of human civilization, forcing the local population to complete the selection process of the Great Filter amid the turbulence of that progress, and to complete it fast.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Dead Man's Switch
ResearchProjectDef.description:
The dead man's switch is a mechanical safety mechanism intended to automatically terminate active equipment the moment its operator is incapacitated.

Before mankind explored space, they found that this mechanism would eventually let an artificial intelligence understand, to some degree... the meaning of death.
 That discovery carried mankind into a new era of history...

 the era of the fifth-level artificial intelligence.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Defense Equipment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Equipment for colony defense and riot control.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Military Equipment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Equipment designed primarily for automatroid use. Most of it is heavy enough that it is unsuitable for a human to handle.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Heavy Weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Special equipment built around heavy automatroids and specialized models. No matter how strong a human is, they simply cannot lift it, so it is unsuitable for human use.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Battle Friends
ResearchProjectDef.description: The records are old enough that we have never established whether their proper designation was "battle frames" or "battle friends". Either way they are automatroids, serving as a frame for operating equipment or as a companion in a fight.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Hybrid Engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Biological-mechanical hybrid technology was established during the Third World War. Mercenaries from some of the belligerent nations founded an armed state made up of military personnel, meant to secure rights for mercenaries whom the humanitarian conventions had never protected, and used drones and synthetic prosthetics to return discharged wounded veterans to the battlefield.\n\nThe world's militaries soon recognized what biomechanical hybrids meant for modern warfare, and armed their own forces with them.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Biosynthetic Prosthetics
ResearchProjectDef.description: As automatroid and bionic engineering advanced, manufacturing bionic automatroids with biological-mechanical hybrid technology became possible.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Organ Replacement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Mankind gave up a great deal in that long war... and even where the loss could later be made good, some things were gone forever.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Heavy Automatroid
ResearchProjectDef.description: These heavy machines once stood ready for total war between nations. Fortunately, war on that scale does not happen often.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ergonomics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Humanoid automatroids are humanoid because, compared to other animals, a human is an exceptionally cooperative test subject for training a neural network in a wide range of tactical movements. Humanoid automatroids trained and produced this way also inherit compatibility with human environments and human tools.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Specialized design
ResearchProjectDef.description: Following the end of the Cold War, rapid breakthroughs in microelectronics freed automatroid configuration and systems integration from the constraints of amorphous neural circuitry. From then on automatroid designs could branch into specialized models at a lower development cost, meeting the low-intensity but complicated demands of the new era of warfare - counter-terrorism, policing actions and the like.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Next-Gen Weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: The arms race centered on biological-mechanical hybrids continued all the way to the Fourth World War, and had reached unimaginable heights long before anyone recognized the problem.\n\nWhat followed were the so-called next-generation weapons and the next-generation war they brought with them - a war that very nearly ended Earth.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced control
ResearchProjectDef.description: In the millennium, when printed circuits became widespread, the improvement in computing power and density of microelectronics laid the foundation for more advanced cluster control link integration, and brought possibilities for more intelligent production lines and automatroid designs.
